note_en: Ethan Liu's merged model report, posted to the drylab channel on 25 September, carries this exact permutation result. Its table gives rain by five stages in the second crop a permutation p of 0.010 and a shuffling cost of +19.8 kg/ha, while warm nights (threshold) cost +0.2 kg/ha at p = 0.812 and humid days +0.0 kg/ha at p = 0.921. The report also says the smallest possible p in the test is 0.010, so p = 0.010 means the term never lost in 100 shuffles.
note_zh: Ethan Liu 於 9 月 25 日貼在乾實驗室頻道的 merged model 報告列出完全相同的置換檢定結果：二期的分期降雨 p = 0.010、打亂後誤差增加 19.8 kg/ha；暖夜門檻項只增加 0.2 kg/ha（p = 0.812），高濕日為 0.0 kg/ha（p = 0.921）。報告並說明該檢定可得的最小 p 值就是 0.010。

note_en: The merged model report defines the common row set as 11 counties, 2007 to 2025, 399 county-seasons over both crops, and its area-weighted year-mean chart is drawn on exactly those rows. Rows excluded are 2001 to 2006 and five counties with no usable station. The report calls that chart Figure 1; the wiki numbers it Figure 6.
note_zh: 該報告把共同資料列定義為 11 個縣市、2007 至 2025 年、兩期合計 399 個縣季，面積加權的年平均圖就是畫在這組資料列上。被排除的是 2001 至 2006 年以及五個沒有可用測站的縣市。報告把這張圖編為 Figure 1，維基頁則編為 Figure 6。

note_en: The merged report's best second-crop model is typhoon wind, rain days at or above 150 mm, radiation deficit, heading cold hours, lodging gust, the v3 potential terms and rain by five stages, which is the wiki's second-crop list term for term. The best first-crop model is shorter: dark spell, radiation deficit, v3 potential terms, humid days (threshold) and humidity by five stages. Warm nights and hours above 35 C are in the wiki's first-crop list but not in that model, and the report recommends dropping the warm-night and humidity threshold terms.
note_zh: 報告中二期最佳模型為颱風風速、日雨量 ≥150 mm 日數、輻射不足、抽穗期低溫時數、倒伏陣風、v3 潛勢項與分期降雨，與維基的二期清單逐項相符。一期最佳模型只有暗期、輻射不足、v3 潛勢項、高濕日門檻與分期濕度；維基一期清單多出的暖夜與 35 度以上時數並不在其中，報告反而建議刪除暖夜與濕度門檻項。

note_en: The merged report gives the second-crop trend-only baseline as 591 kg/ha and the best merged model as 378 kg/ha under leave-one-year-out, a 36% reduction; with the term search nested inside each fold the model scores 400 kg/ha, which is 32% below the baseline. So 32% matches the stricter nested number and not the headline leave-one-year-out one. Whoever wrote the page should say which of the two the figure is.
note_zh: 報告給出的二期趨勢基線為 591 kg/ha，最佳 merged 模型在 leave-one-year-out 下為 378 kg/ha，降幅約 36%；若把變數搜尋嵌在每一折之內，模型為 400 kg/ha，比基線低 32%。因此 32% 對應的是較嚴格的 nested 數字。頁面作者需要說明引用的是哪一個。

note_en: The merged report states that the temperature, humidity and rain features were built from the ERA5 township daily series, with bias-corrected temperature and rain and raw ERA5 relative humidity, then area-weighted to county. That settles the ERA5 half of the sentence for the historical fit. The report says nothing about what a live deployment would read, and the only Central Weather Administration mention is that the earlier county model used CWA dekad data.
note_zh: 報告寫明溫度、濕度與降雨特徵是由 ERA5 鄉鎮日資料建立，溫度與雨量經偏差校正、相對濕度用 ERA5 原始值，再面積加權到縣市，因此歷史擬合使用 ERA5 這一半獲得佐證。報告沒有談到實際運作時會讀什麼資料，提到中央氣象署之處只說早期縣級模型用的是 CWA 旬資料。

note_en: The merged report works on county-season rows from 2001 to 2025 and names the Agriculture and Food Agency as the body that publishes the realised yields, proposing to freeze a second-crop model now and score it when AFA publishes 2026. That supports the agency and the 2001 start, though the report itself does not spell out the full yield-statistics series the wiki cites.
note_zh: 報告的縣季資料涵蓋 2001 至 2025 年，並指名農糧署為公布實際產量的單位，提議先凍結二期模型、待農糧署公布 2026 年資料後評分。這支持了資料來源機關與 2001 年起算，但報告本身沒有完整寫出維基所引的產量統計序列。

note_en: The 25 September merged report says the 2026 data are v3's frozen blind test and were left untouched, and proposes following the same protocol for the second crop. The report is dated the day before the 26 September freeze the wiki claims, so Discord supports the existence of the frozen 2026 first-crop blind test without fixing the date. Ethan Liu can confirm the exact freeze date.
note_zh: 9 月 25 日的 merged 報告指出 2026 年資料是 v3 的凍結盲測、完全未被使用，並建議二期沿用同一流程。報告日期正好在維基所稱 9 月 26 日凍結的前一天，因此 Discord 佐證了 2026 一期盲測確實存在，但沒有確定日期。確切凍結日期可向 Ethan Liu 確認。

note_en: The DNPH activity report Timmy posted to the drylab channel on 7 October gives, for the samyQ construct at 7.25 mU per mL of supernatant, a project-scale rate of 44.0 mg ACC per litre per hour and 1.056 g ACC per litre per day. The report marks the measurement as one well at one time point, above the detection limit and below the quantitation limit, and tells the modeller to treat it as an order-of-magnitude upper estimate with zero as a legitimate lower bound.
note_zh: Timmy 於 10 月 7 日貼在乾實驗室頻道的 DNPH 活性報告寫明：samyQ 構築在每毫升上清 7.25 mU 之下，專案尺度的分解速率為 44.0 mg ACC/L/h、1.056 g ACC/L/day。報告同時標明這是單孔單時間點、高於偵測極限但低於定量極限，建議建模時當成量級上界，下界為零。

note_en: The main table of the 7 October DNPH report lists exactly these rows: WB800+PLP A540 0.388, OD600 3.322, 0 mU per mL as the blank by definition; csn+PLP A540 0.404, OD600 2.638, 3.31 mU per mL marked below the detection limit; samyQ+PLP A540 0.423, OD600 3.058, 7.25 mU per mL marked detected and below the quantitation limit. The report is built from the FlexA A540 readings and the DNPH protocol, with n = 1.
note_zh: 10 月 7 日 DNPH 報告的主表逐列列出：WB800+PLP A540 0.388、OD600 3.322、依定義為 0 mU/mL 空白；csn+PLP A540 0.404、OD600 2.638、3.31 mU/mL 標示低於偵測極限；samyQ+PLP A540 0.423、OD600 3.058、7.25 mU/mL 標示偵測到但低於定量極限。報告資料來自 FlexA A540 讀值與 DNPH protocol，n = 1。

note_en: The report's standard-curve section gives curve A, fitted with deactivated supernatant present, as y = 0.18695x + 0.31853 with R-squared 0.99907 and a residual standard deviation of 0.00715, and that curve is the one used throughout. It then derives LOD = 3.3 sigma / m = 0.1261 mM and LOQ = 10 sigma / m = 0.3822 mM from those residuals.
note_zh: 報告的標準曲線一節給出曲線 A（含去活化上清）為 y = 0.18695x + 0.31853，R² 0.99907，殘差標準差 0.00715，且全報告一律採用這條曲線。接著由殘差導出 LOD = 3.3σ/m = 0.1261 mM、LOQ = 10σ/m = 0.3822 mM。

note_en: The report calls this its single most important correction: the standard concentrations on the original file were computed with 110 microlitres as the denominator while the standard mix actually totals 160.6 microlitres, so the labelled concentrations are too high by a factor of 1.460 and every derived activity had been overstated by 46 percent. All numbers in the report are recomputed from the recipe. The report also says this still has to be confirmed in writing with Gabriel, because a reason for using 110 microlitres would force a full recalculation.
note_zh: 報告把這點列為最重要的更正：原始檔案的標準品濃度是以 110 微升為分母計算，實際標準品總體積為 160.6 微升，因此標示濃度高估 1.460 倍，先前推算的活性全部高估 46%。報告中的數字都已依配方重算。報告並註明此事仍須與 Gabriel 書面確認，若他採用 110 微升另有理由，全部數字必須重算。

note_en: The report's protocol section gives the sample reaction as 100 microlitres of filtered supernatant with 1 M BP buffer at pH 8.0 and 0.5 M ACC, a final ACC concentration of 43.03 mM, 30 minutes at 30 degrees, read as A540 after DNPH colour development. WB800 plus PLP host supernatant is the blank, and the report explains that this blank also removes the host's own secreted background. PLP is matched between standards and samples so its own colour is not read as activity.
note_zh: 報告的 protocol 一節列出樣品反應為 100 微升過濾上清，加 1 M BP buffer pH 8.0 與 0.5 M ACC，ACC 終濃度 43.03 mM，30 °C 反應 30 分鐘，DNPH 呈色後讀 A540。空白為 WB800+PLP 宿主上清，報告說明此空白同時扣除宿主自身分泌物背景，且標準品與樣品的 PLP 已匹配，不會把 PLP 呈色誤判為活性。

note_en: The report makes this argument under the heading that signal does not track biomass: the OD600 order is WB800 3.322, samyQ 3.058, csn 2.638, while among the PLP-matched samples samyQ reads 0.423 against WB800's 0.388. It states that a background driven by cell density or secreted carbonyl metabolites would make the two orders agree, so the argument rules out a biomass artefact and survives even if the standard curve is wrong. Its own ranking line quotes csn at 0.386, the well without PLP.
note_zh: 報告在「訊號與菌量不相關」一節提出同樣論證：菌量排序為 WB800 3.322 > samyQ 3.058 > csn 2.638，而在 PLP 匹配的樣品中 samyQ 讀值 0.423 高於 WB800 的 0.388。報告指出若背景來自菌量或分泌的羰基代謝物，兩種排序應一致，因此可排除生物量造成的假訊號，且此論證不依賴濃度換算。報告該段引用的 csn 0.386 是未加 PLP 的那一孔。

note_en: The report records the samyQ culture at OD600 3.058, which is the 3.06 on the page, and confirms the batch duration was not among the recorded parameters. It also flags that all three OD readings sat outside the spectrophotometer's linear range after a two-fold dilution (1.319, 1.529, 1.661), so the absolute biomass is understated and only the ranking is safe. Nothing in the report supports the 29 minute doubling time or the 5.9 doublings; those come from the literature.
note_zh: 報告記錄 samyQ 培養的 OD600 為 3.058，即頁面上的 3.06，也確認批次時間並未記錄。報告另標明三個 OD 讀值在二倍稀釋後仍為 1.319／1.529／1.661，全部超出分光光度計線性範圍，絕對菌量被低估，只有排序可信。報告沒有提供 29 分鐘倍增時間或 5.9 次倍增的依據，那些來自文獻。

note_en: The report is dated 7 October, is built from the FlexA A540 readings in DNPH.xlsx with the protocol from DNPH.docx, states n = 1, and gives 7.2514e-9 mol per mL per min, which is the 7.2514 mU per mL on the page. It describes the sample as 100 microlitres of filtered culture supernatant from the WB800, csn and samyQ cultures and never mentions a reactor or a permeate batch, so open question 6 is still open and this wording may need changing.
note_zh: 報告日期為 10 月 7 日，資料來自 DNPH.xlsx 的 FlexA A540 讀值與 DNPH.docx 的 protocol，標明 n = 1，並給出 7.2514 × 10⁻⁹ mol·mL⁻¹·min⁻¹，即頁面上的 7.2514 mU/mL。但報告把樣品描述為 WB800、csn、samyQ 培養的 100 微升過濾上清，完全沒有提到反應器或 permeate 批次，因此第 6 號未決問題仍未解決，頁面用詞可能需要修正。

note_en: The report supports the substrate side of this calculation: the measured point is 43.03 mM ACC and its saturation table shows the correction factor for several Km values, 1.035 at Km 1.5 mM and 1.116 at Km 5 mM, so the page's 93% of Vmax and 7.82 mU per mL follow from Km 3.4 mM. But the report lists kcat and Km in its parameter table as not yet determined, to be supplied as ranges of 0.5 to 10 per second and 1.5 to 17 mM, and says a single operating point cannot separate Km from Vmax. The 1.96 mg per litre figure is not in the report.
note_zh: 報告支持此計算的受質面：量測點為 43.03 mM ACC，飽和度表列出不同 Km 的修正倍率（Km 1.5 mM 為 1.035、Km 5 mM 為 1.116），因此頁面的 93% Vmax 與 7.82 mU/mL 在 Km = 3.4 mM 下成立。但報告的參數表把 kcat 與 Km 列為尚未確定，建議以 0.5–10 s⁻¹ 與 1.5–17 mM 的區間呈現，並指出單一操作點無法分離 Km 與 Vmax。1.96 mg/L 並未出現在報告中。

note_en: Two Discord records unsettle parts of this. The DNPH report writes that ACCD acts as a homotrimer and uses 36,800 g per mol as a provisional monomer mass that has to be recomputed for the actual construct, which does not agree with the page's homotetramer of about 144 kDa. Separately, Ryan told Timmy in July that the ordered acdS sequence is most likely from Pseudomonas entomophila and that he used Pseudomonas putida only for the structure work, so the strain the kinetic constants are attached to should be checked before the freeze.
note_zh: 兩筆 Discord 紀錄動搖了這條敘述的一部分。DNPH 報告寫 ACCD 以 homotrimer 作用，並以 36 800 g/mol 作為暫用的單體分子量、須依實際構築重算，與頁面所寫約 144 kDa 的 homotetramer 不一致。另外，Ryan 七月回覆 Timmy 時表示實際訂購的 acdS 序列最可能來自 Pseudomonas entomophila，而 Pseudomonas putida 只用於結構分析，因此動力學常數所掛的菌株應在凍結前確認。

evidence.quote: 1. The sequence is most likely from Pseudomonas entomophila, the protein I gave you previously

note_en: Phoebe Chen posted the team's chlorophyll equation in the wetlab progression channel in June, with the same coefficients and the same normalisation by fresh tissue weight that the page uses. Her message writes OD633 where the page writes OD663; 663 nm is the standard reading and the message is almost certainly a typing slip, but someone should confirm it against the protocol document. The 80 percent acetone extraction step does not appear anywhere in Discord.
note_zh: Phoebe Chen 六月在 wetlab progression 頻道貼出團隊的葉綠素計算式，係數與以鮮重正規化的做法都與頁面一致。她的訊息寫成 OD633，頁面寫 OD663；663 nm 才是標準讀值，訊息幾乎可以確定是打字誤植，但仍應對照 protocol 文件確認。80% 丙酮萃取這一步在 Discord 中沒有出現。

note_en: Discord confirms the three-protectant selection: Timmy wrote the shortlist as ACC Deaminase, BoPep4, LEA14 in the math-model channel on 3 August, and Felix set the same three plus MD as the modelling directions on 12 September. On spelling, the team's own channel is titled BoPep4 Design Strategy while the source paper Timmy circulated is titled with BoPEP4, so the published spelling supports BoPEP4. Discord does not assign BoPEP4, LEA14 and ACCD to the stresses the way the page does.
note_zh: Discord 佐證了三種保護劑的選定：Timmy 於 8 月 3 日在數學模型頻道寫下 ACC Deaminase、BoPep4、LEA14，Felix 於 9 月 12 日把同樣三者加上 MD 列為建模方向。拼法方面，團隊自己的頻道名為 BoPep4 Design Strategy，而 Timmy 分享的原始論文標題採用 BoPEP4，故已出版的寫法支持 BoPEP4。Discord 沒有像頁面那樣把三者各自對應到特定逆境。

evidence.quote: the four directions to complete before 9/26

note_en: The team's own July dossiers give the mature BoPep4 sequence as GILIGSKKRPREPHSSGKPGGHN, 23 residues, numbered G1 through N23, which fits the one-to-one numbering the page describes. The BoPep4 against AtPep1 interface table posted on 14 July marks positions 7, 9, 12, 15, 16, 17, 20, 22 and 23 as the same residue and 8, 13, 14, 18 and 21 as different; position 19 is not in that table because it makes no receptor contact. Nine of the ten identities the page lists are therefore supported, and the count of ten out of 23 itself is not stated in Discord.
note_zh: 團隊七月的兩份檔案都寫出成熟 BoPep4 序列 GILIGSKKRPREPHSSGKPGGHN，共 23 個殘基、編號 G1 至 N23，與頁面所述一對一編號相符。7 月 14 日貼出的 BoPep4 對 AtPep1 介面表把 7、9、12、15、16、17、20、22、23 標為相同殘基，8、13、14、18、21 為不同；第 19 位不在表中，因為它不與受體接觸。頁面所列十個相同位置中有九個得到佐證，但「23 取 10」這個數字本身 Discord 沒有寫出。

evidence.quote: | 17 | Gly — hphob (Val299) | Gly — same | conserved (steric, G17 critical) |

note_en: The 16 on the page traces to a specific document: the alanine-scan dossier Felix posted on 25 July says S15 and S16 are invariant across all 16 characterized Pep-family peptides. The 17 traces to the source paper Timmy circulated, whose figure caption describes an alignment of nine BoPROPEPs and eight AtPROPEPs, seventeen sequences with BoPROPEP4 among the nine. So the two counts come from different sets and whoever reconciles them should start from those two documents.
note_zh: 頁面上的 16 可追溯到一份具體文件：Felix 於 7 月 25 日貼出的丙胺酸掃描檔案寫明 S15 與 S16 在全部 16 條已特徵化的 Pep 家族胜肽中不變。17 則來自 Timmy 分享的原始論文，其圖說描述的是九條 BoPROPEP 與八條 AtPROPEP 的比對，共十七條，而 BoPROPEP4 即在那九條之中。兩個數字出自不同集合，釐清時應從這兩份文件著手。

evidence.quote: (B) Alignment of nine BoPROPEPs and eight AtPROPEPs reveals

note_en: The 15 to 23 window on the MD and methodology pages comes from the team's July work: the tandem-repeat dossier Timmy posted on 25 July calls SSGKPGGHN, mature residues 15 to 23, BoPep4's C-terminal conserved motif, and docked eight tandem copies of it. The same documents give the mature sequence with Gly at 21, so the page's claim about BoPEP4's own Gly21 is consistent with the sequence the team used. Discord does not settle whether the conserved block should be described as stopping at 20.
note_zh: MD 與方法頁使用的 15 至 23 窗口源自團隊七月的工作：Timmy 於 7 月 25 日貼出的 tandem repeat 檔案把 SSGKPGGHN（成熟序列第 15 至 23 位）稱為 BoPep4 的 C 端保守 motif，並對其做了最多八次串聯的對接。同一批文件給出的成熟序列第 21 位確實是 Gly，與頁面關於 BoPEP4 自身 Gly21 的說法一致。保守區是否應描述為止於第 20 位，Discord 無法判定。
